summary: Security vulnerability GHSA-82j2-j2ch-gfr8 in rustls-webpki dependency remains unpatched in temporalio 1.26.0 wheel. Requesting update of Rust dependencies to include rustls-webpki >= 0.103.13 and new SDK release.
userImpact: Users cannot update to the latest Python SDK without exposing applications to a known security vulnerability in the bundled cryptographic library.
rootCause: Rust dependencies in the Python SDK wheel have not been updated to include the patched rustls-webpki >= 0.103.13.
proposedFix: Update SDK Rust dependencies to include rustls-webpki >= 0.103.13 and publish a new temporalio release.
resolutionDetails: Dependencies were updated to include the patched rustls-webpki version in a subsequent SDK release.
keyQuote: Could the SDK's Rust bridge dependencies be updated so the published Python wheels include rustls-webpki >=0.103.13
